title: GrainLookResponse
description: Grain -> RepairOS: POST /projects/{id}/scans/{sid}/look -- Grain's judgement of the photos of one record against the design. Also the `photos` member of a /call response. A judgement, not a measurement: observation confidence is a number 0-1, unlike fix confidence (a word). Synchronous and slow today, cached by content (cached: true). Pinned against a private recorded Grain fixture (private/grain/observed/), plus target fields marked x-target. status is ok, error (judgement carries error/raw) or not_checked (judgement null, reason says why). Camera poses, crop boxes and harness rows are not inputs yet (target T5). Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.

model.description: An identifier Grain reports; RepairOS does not read it.

provider.description: An identifier Grain reports; RepairOS does not read it.

matches_design.description: False with mostly missing/unsure observations means photos of another product.

call_id.description: Target T6: with detach: true, a 202 carries call_id; poll GET /call/{call_id}.

part.description: A Grain part name, or null when none could be named.

state.description: Maps 1:1 onto Finding.state (source grain.look). /call turns loose into reseat.
